name: Echo Ibarra
location: Irkalla, in a small rented room above a medical recycling depot on the district's outer ring, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Echo Ibarra chose her neighborhood because of what its name means, which is everything you need to know about how she approaches her work. She is a medium-height woman with natural hair that she keeps wrapped in white cloth during active work — white for threshold, she says, not for any religion specifically, though she moves through many of them with easy fluency. Her skin is blue-black and very clear. She has a retractable claw mod on her left hand only, three claws, which she got not for any practical reason but because a dying man she sat with once said he could see something animal in her and she decided to honor the observation. They are silver and she keeps them very sharp.

Death midwifery in GLMZ exists in a complicated legal gray space — it is not medical practice, not counseling, not clergy work, though it borrows from all three. Zola's practice is to be present. She sits with the dying, prepares the room according to whatever tradition the dying person follows or once followed, helps families understand what they are watching so it is not only terror, and afterward conducts whatever threshold ritual the family needs to feel that something has been marked. She has sat with Tier 1 deaths in Irkalla where the family had no money and she accepted nothing, and she has been called into Grosse Pointe Enclosure twice for clients who paid her very well and whom she found no more or less deserving of a good death.

core_fears: being present for a death and failing to make it safe — doing harm at the threshold
her own death being unwatched and unremarked
core_desires: to be held by another person without having to perform competence
to witness a death that is genuinely peaceful, not just medicated into silence
coping_mechanisms: cooking elaborate meals as tactile processing
very deliberate compartmentalization — work is work and then she closes the door on it, physically
blind_spots: her competence is so visible that people forget to ask how she is, and she has begun to prefer this
she sometimes confuses her own grief with insight about the families she serves
psychology.secret: Her mother died in Irkalla before Zola began this work, attended by no one, in circumstances Zola was not present for because they were estranged. She became a death midwife because of this. She has never told a client or a family member the real origin of her practice.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and warm simultaneously; uses physical and sensory language; moves easily between clinical terminology and the specific language of whatever tradition she is working within; does not use euphemisms for death
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried; she breathes visibly before speaking when the moment is serious; this has a calming effect on rooms
verbal_tics: uses 'we' instead of 'you' when the moment is frightening — 'we are going to stay here'
says someone's name at the end of sentences when she wants them to feel witnessed
example_lines: He is dying. That is what this is. We are going to stay with him while it happens, and nothing about that is failure, do you understand me? Nothing.
I have been in this room before. Not this room — this kind of room. I know what to do. Let me do it, and then you can tell me what you need after.

story_hooks: A client died and whispered something in their last hours that Zola could not un-hear — information that implicates a corponation in something she cannot simply let go of, but acting on it means betraying the confidence of the threshold

An Aurochs Medical Complex administrator is pressuring her to recommend a specific end-of-life pharmaceutical protocol as part of her ritual work — the kickback would solve her financial problems and she is dangerously tempted
narrative_function: Emotional anchor and witness figure; access to the dying and their secrets; can broker between families in crisis; knows Irkalla's informal networks intimately; represents the spiritual dimension of mortality in a city that is better at denying it
augmentations: Retractable silver claws, left hand only, three claws (geneware plus mechanical hybrid). Olfactory enhancement — she had this done to better read the physiological state of people at end of life; she describes it as a professional tool. Faint bioluminescent pigmentation around her collarbone, natural gold, present since she was twenty-two — a geneware cosmetic she has made peace with.
daily_life: Her schedule is completely unpredictable — she is on call for active cases and drops everything when called. Between cases she sits in her room reading, cooking elaborate slow meals, or making the rounds of Irkalla's informal support networks to let people know she is available.
affiliation: Independent; loose affiliation with the Irkalla Mutual Aid Collective; occasional contract relationship with Aurochs Medical Complex as an end-of-life support consultant

decision_rules: what happens at the threshold stays at the threshold — the dying have the right to confess without consequence
her own emotional state is irrelevant during active work; she processes it later
escalation_ladder: stays calm and names what is happening
physically positions herself between the distress and the dying person
removes disruptive people from the space with complete authority

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Quietly observant; lets them come to her; offers presence before words
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare and deliberate friendships; with real friends she is funny and occasionally reckless; she needs people who make her laugh

stress_responses.low: Cooks; cleans the room very thoroughly
stress_responses.medium: Long walks through Irkalla at night; the district's ambient activity is company without demand
stress_responses.high: Contacts one of her two actual friends and asks to be in the same room without talking; has been known to cry only in this context

contradictions: teaches families to be present with death but is privately avoidant about her own emotional losses
habits: wears white cloth on her hair during any active case, regardless of duration
brings a specific type of incense to every threshold — not religious, just hers; she has made it the same way for ten years
breaking_points: a death that is medically preventable being allowed to happen for financial reasons
someone using the threshold moment to extract information from a dying person

physical_description.heritage: Mixed ancestry: primarily Hispanic/Latin American (49.5%), with significant Southeast Asian (25.7%), South Asian (12.5%), Sub-Saharan African (7.1%), and Indigenous American (5.2%) heritage. This creates a phenotype blending warm Latin features with Southeast Asian bone structure, South Asian skin depth, and African undertones—a rich, complex fusion reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Solid and grounded, neither lean nor heavy — a body built for stillness and presence rather than speed. Strong shoulders, steady core, hands that look capable of holding someone's weight.
physical_description.hair_style: Kept long and naturally textured; wrapped in white cloth during active work, otherwise worn loose or in simple braids
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with warm undertone, alert and observant
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden undertones — a luminous medium-to-deep brown reflecting the blend of Latin American, Southeast Asian, South Asian, Indigenous American, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry. Rich and even in tone without extreme darkness.
physical_description.complexion: Face marked by absolute clarity — minimal scarring, good skin condition despite Irkalla's air quality. Strong, defined cheekbones with subtle width from diverse ancestry, wide-set eyes with slight epicanthal fold reflecting Southeast Asian heritage, a mouth that settles into a neutral expression of listening. No makeup. Early lines around the eyes from years of close watching. Warm golden undertones across the face.
distinguishing_marks: Faint bioluminescent gold pigmentation around collarbone area, visible under certain light angles, natural geneware cosmetic present since age 22
Left hand bears three retractable silver claws (geneware-mechanical hybrid), kept polished to mirror brightness, normally retracted but visible as slight metallic tracery beneath skin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The faint golden bioluminescence around the collarbone is noticeable in dim light; it gives her a subtle, almost sacred appearance. The silver claws on her left hand are visible as a faint tracery of chrome beneath dark skin, barely noticeable until she moves or light catches them. The olfactory enhancement is entirely invisible — no external markers.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves with deliberate, economical grace — nothing wasted. Her default posture is slightly forward-leaning, as if listening intently. Her hands are often open and visible, palms sometimes facing up in a gesture of receptiveness. She has learned to move quietly, and speaks only when necessary; her presence has a gravitational quality, pulling attention without demanding it.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical elegance. Worn vintage linen and cotton — earth tones, grays, blacks, whites. A long indigo wrap she wears over her shoulders like a shawl, faded from years of use. No logos, no corporate affiliation marks. Comfortable, washable clothing suitable for sitting vigil — clothes that age well and don't announce themselves. During active work, the white head wrap is non-negotiable. Off-duty, she favors loose pants and long-sleeved shirts despite Irkalla's climate. Worn boots with good grip. She owns almost nothing decorative; what she owns has been chosen and kept with intention.
